question: How many medals were won by the Indian team in Archery World Cup Stage 2 at Shanghai, China in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian team won a total of **7 medals** at the Archery World Cup Stage 2 held in Shanghai, China, in May 2025.
 
• The medal tally included **2 gold medals, 4 silver medals, and 1 bronze medals**, showcasing India's excellence in archery.
 
• Indian archers performed exceptionally well in both **compound and recurve categories**, securing top positions in individual and team events.
 
• The Archery World Cup is an annual international competition organized by the **World Archery Federation**, where top archers from around the world compete.
 
• This achievement reflects India’s growing dominance in the sport and highlights the development of archery infrastructure and training programs in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Archery World Cup **

 
 
• The Archery World Cup is a prestigious event conducted annually to determine the best archers globally.
 
• The competition features events in two main disciplines: recurve and compound archery.
 
• India has emerged as a strong contender in archery, producing world-class athletes through improved training facilities and coaching.
 
• Participation in such events boosts international recognition and strengthens India's medal prospects in upcoming competitions, including the Olympics.
